canada.title: Premier says Manitoba nearing limits of what it can do on affordability, so he's going after big corporations
canada.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says the provincial government is reaching the limits of what it can do to ease the cost of living without sacrificing the revenue needed to fund public services, and that corporate giants need to do their part.

canada.title: Family appeals for help finding missing Penticton senior with dementia
canada.summary: The disappearance of 72-year-old Penticton resident Lawrence Jerry McAnulty, who goes by Jerry, is especially concerning as the senior has dementia.

canada.title: U.S. ground stop results in hundreds of cancelled flights at Toronto’s two airports
canada.summary: Hundreds of flights were cancelled at Toronto’s two airports after the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration issued a ground stop order on Friday, leaving many travellers stranded.

canada.title: Alberta changing royalty system to encourage oilsands production, new investment
canada.summary: Alberta is rolling out a new resource royalty program it says is aimed at incentivizing new investment and development in the oilsands by offering guaranteed, predictable rates.

canada.title: 3 dead after boat crash in flooded river near Squamish, B.C.
canada.summary: Three people are confirmed dead after a boat crashed on the Squamish River on Thursday.

canada.title: Trial starts for former air cadet instructor accused of sex offences involving minors
canada.summary: A former flight instructor of air cadets went on trial Friday, accused of exposing his genitals to a minor, supplying an underage person with liquor, and counselling a minor to touch another minor for a sexual purpose while in a position of trust or authority.

canada.title: Montreal police use tear gas to disperse downtown student protest
canada.summary: Montreal police deployed tear gas and moved to disperse crowds Friday afternoon after a student demonstration led to clashes with officers clad in riot gear.

canada.title: Critics of Manitoba Hydro's planned generating plant expansion welcome board's call for fewer new gas turbines
canada.summary: The provincial energy regulator is advising Manitoba Hydro to install fewer gas turbines at a major facility in Brandon than the Crown corporation wants to build — a recommendation welcomed by critics of the utility's $3-billion proposal.

canada.title: Gunfire caused communications outage in North West River area, says Bell
canada.summary: A telecommunications outage that saw two Labrador schools close early on Thursday may have been the result of gunfire, according to Bell.

canada.title: Family, police believe missing Ontario teen is in Sask.
canada.summary: On Friday, Saskatchewan RCMP shared a news release on behalf of Durham Regional Police asking for the public's help finding Cairo. The 14-year-old was last seen in Courtice, about an hour outside Toronto, on Sept. 20.

canada.title: Wapiti Regional Library closing 6 rural branches in Sask.
canada.summary: The six library branches slated for closure in December are in Alvena, Gronlid, Mistatim, Pilger, Prairie River and St. Benedict.

canada.title: Defence hammers RCMP officer over lack of specifics in interview of man accused of 1st-degree murder
canada.summary: Terry Cole told an RCMP officer that Matthew Kavanagh killed Michael Fillier, but his defence lawyer pointed out on Friday that the officer didn't ask for any specific details that could have confirmed his account.

canada.title: Endometriosis care in Quebec inadequate, says women's health group in open letter
canada.summary: A women's health advocacy group is calling out Quebec's lack of expertise in endometriosis care and is asking that pain associated with the chronic condition be recognized as a criterion when prioritizing surgeries.

canada.summary: Nova Scotia Power and the company that wants to build an $8-billion data centre campus in Point Tupper, N.S., have signed two documents that lay out conditions for connecting the project to the provincial grid.

canada.title: Woman and 2 kids killed in Highway 16 collision, 8-year-old critically injured
canada.summary: A 37-year-old woman and two children died, while an eight-year-old was critically injured in the crash with a semi-truck about 230 kilometres east of Edmonton.

canada.title: People who need food hampers have to keep coming back month after month: Waterloo region food bank's report
canada.summary: The Food Bank of Waterloo Region has released its annual community impact report. It found that fewer individuals needed food assistance, but those who did had to keep coming back to food distribution programs.
